{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Revyia]] was home to a '''temple''' created for members of the [[Tyia]] philosophy. The temple was grown from the largest [[Tree/Legends|trees]] on the planet. Following [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] wherein significant numbers of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], [[Revwien/Legends|Revwien]] masters of the Tyia philosophy gathered in this temple, and after conferring, dispatched some of their best adepts into the galaxy to find and aid any surviving members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
